founder.title: Why Forge?
founder.p1: In fifteen years as a personal trainer, I've realized two things: most professional training plans are poorly put together, and because the admin is such a chore, many trainers just give up and improvise.
founder.p2: High-quality, structured programming usually takes too much time, so it doesn't get done.
founder.p3: Forge is built to change that. It's a tool that makes it easy to generate a plan that is actually defensible, whether you're coaching others or just managing your own training.
founder.bullet_logic_body: It's not about admin theatre or pretty PDFs. It's about using solid frameworks (PAR-Q+, ACSM risk stratification, Prochaska) to build a baseline that makes sense.
founder.bullet_pro_body: It works as a professional assistant to speed up client delivery, or as a personal tool for anyone who wants a structured program without the manual headache.
founder.bullet_filter_body: The AI handles the repetitive drafting. You review it, fix it, and own it.
founder.p4: The goal isn't to automate coaching. It's to make sure that "it's too much work" is no longer an excuse for a bad plan.
founder.signature: — André Periquito, MSc Exercise & Health · Exercise Physiologist & Personal Trainer

faq.title: Questions trainers ask before signing up.
faq.q1_q: Is the AI plan good enough to send to clients as-is?
faq.q1_a: It's good enough to be a strong starting point. You'll edit volume, swap exercises, adjust language for your client. Forge is faster than starting from a blank page — not a replacement for your judgement.
faq.q2_q: What if my client has injuries or medical conditions?
faq.q2_a: PAR-Q+ flags trigger conditional logic. Cardiac flags default the plan to low-intensity. Joint flags exclude high-impact patterns. You always have final approval before generation.
faq.q3_q: Can I use my own branding on the PDF?
faq.q3_a: Yes. Upload your logo and business name in Settings. Every PDF export is branded with your studio identity, not Forge's.
faq.q4_q: What happens to my client data?
faq.q4_a: Stored in Supabase (EU region). You can export or delete any client record at any time. Forge does not share or sell client data — ever.
